title: SaaS terms wall of text
prompt: I need comprehensive B2B SaaS terms. We offer a project management tool for construction subs. Features: task boards, file upload up to 500MB per project, SMS notifications via Twilio, integrations with Procore and QuickBooks, SSO for enterprise, API access on Pro plan only, 99.5% uptime target not guarantee, data hosted in US-East, backups daily, support email 24h response business days, annual contracts with auto-renew unless 30-day notice, monthly also available, price increases capped at 5% yearly, free trial 14 days no card, onboarding calls optional, customers may invite unlimited viewers, contractors are data controllers for their uploads, we are processor for account metadata, subprocessors include AWS, Stripe, Twilio, Sentry, OpenAI for optional AI features, customers must not use for illegal jobsite discrimination, arbitration Delaware, class action waiver, limitation of liability capped at 12 months fees paid, no consequential damages, indemnity for customer content violations, DMCA agent contact placeholder, export data on termination within 30 days, delete within 90 days unless legal hold, beta features as-is, security questionnaire available on request, SOC2 in progress not certified, penetration test annually, incident notification 72h for confirmed breaches affecting personal data, children not allowed, government users ok, sanctions compliance, assignment only with consent except merger, force majeure, entire agreement, severability, no waiver, notices by email, governing law Delaware, exclusive venue Delaware courts, publicity rights we can list logo unless opt-out email, referral program separate, affiliate terms not included here, SLA credits only for enterprise tier written separately.
premium_expectations: Does not drop late items silently
risk_notes: May truncate or over-summarize — check export PDF

title: Consulting SOW mega-scope
prompt: Master services agreement style consulting engagement between Northwind Analytics LLC (consultant) and three possible client entities (Client A Inc, Client B LLC, or Client B's parent HoldCo) to be confirmed — consultant will provide data engineering, ML model evaluation, dashboard build in Looker, workshop facilitation, documentation, on-site 2 days per quarter in NYC, remote otherwise, 40 hours per month retainer with rollover max 20 hours, additional hours at $275/hr pre-approved in writing, expenses reimbursed with receipts, background check required, security clearance not required, IP: pre-existing tools remain consultant's, deliverables assigned to client upon full payment, open-source components disclosed, warranties disclaimed except non-infringement best efforts, liability cap $50k or fees paid whichever greater, insurance $1M GL, confidentiality 5 years, non-solicit employees 12 months, publicity mutual, subcontractor allowed with notice, termination convenience 30 days, termination cause for material breach 15 day cure, data processing addendum needed if personal data in EU, UK, Brazil, Canada — consultant uses BigQuery and Snowflake, client provides VPC peering optional, SLA for critical bugs 5 business days, acceptance testing 10 business days per milestone, payment net 30, late fee 1.5% monthly, disputes mediation NYC then litigation, assignment restrictions, survival clauses enumerated, schedules A B C for milestones Q1-Q4 with placeholder dates.
